text:
Riley: FYI billing incident: nightly run run_2026_03_30_02 generated ~26 invoices with incorrect amounts (pricing experiment rates applied) and 6 customers also received duplicate PDFs. opening thread to triage.
Chen: thanks. samples?
Riley: INV-STR-0044 (acct-stretch), INV-PIV-0190 (acct-pivotlab), INV-LOFT-300 (acct-loftco). customers report higher-than-expected seat prices and duplicate attachments.
Marta: I got a call from PivotLab at 07:05 UTC — they noticed line items priced at $0.15/token instead of their contracted $0.12/token. ticket FIN-10402 created.
Zane: I pulled pipeline logs. Looks like a pricing-experiment feature flag (pricing/exp_tier_b) was accidentally enabled in production config for the billing job. That caused the rate_lookup stage to return experimental rates. Separately, the invoicer retried some jobs after a transient DB deadlock and the retry created duplicate PDFs because the dedupe check uses write-after-read state that isn't committed during deadlock retries.
Zane: log snippets:
```
2026-03-30T06:59:58Z INFO feature_flag: flag_state pricing/exp_tier_b = ON (scope=billing-run)
2026-03-30T07:00:01Z ERROR db: DeadlockDetected tx=78421
2026-03-30T07:00:02Z WARN invoice_worker: retrying invoice INV-PIV-0190 idempotency_key=null
```
Priya: that explains the wrong amounts + duplicates. Collections: please pause on affected accounts.
Riley: I've tagged acct-stretch, acct-pivotlab, acct-loftco plus 8 others. Paused collections and hold on automated reminder emails.
Chen: finance exposure estimate?
Marta: quick calc ~= $1,900 (experiment overcharge delta) across affected invoices. will finalize after enumeration.
Zane: mitigation plan: 1) revert the inadvertent feature flag toggle 2) add feature-flag gating so experiments are never active during billing runs unless explicitly allowed 3) make dedupe resilient to transient DB retries (move to transactional lock) 4) backfill to regen invoices with correct rates and dedupe duplicates. Est time ~2.5h including backfill.
Riley: pause nightly runner until fix is in. I ran: `systemctl stop invoice-scheduler` on batch05.
deploy-bot: Deploy started branch billing/disable-exp-pricing -> staging
Marta: CS will draft proactive customer outreach. offering $30 courtesy credit for affected customers plus corrected PDFs.
Zane: dry-run backfill: `python billing/backfill.py --run run_2026_03_30_02 --dry-run` -> found 26 invoices with experiment rates, 6 duplicates. saving list to /tmp/billing_run_1784006789.csv
Chen: please don't post credits or journals until we confirm final regen counts. finance needs final list to prepare memos.
deploy-bot: Deploy to production succeeded for billing/disable-exp-pricing @ 2026-03-30T09:12:46Z
Zane: prod backfill completed: regenerated 26 invoices with correct rates, removed 6 duplicate PDFs, uploaded corrected invoices and queued resend. summary: regenerated=26 deduped=6 duration=46m
Marta: finance prepared credits ~$1,920. attaching approval FIN-APPR-672. will post journals after CS sends.
Priya: CS to send corrected invoices + credit this afternoon. template in #support. owners: Zane (fix + backfill), Marta (finance + credits), Riley (operator/coord). please add postmortem once closed. thanks everyone.
